create.name: Rob Schwartz
create.bio:
Rob (Robert) Schwartz is an American author and hypnotist who writes and teaches about pre-birth planning: the idea that we plan our lives, including our hardest challenges, as souls before we are born. He worked in the corporate world until 2003, when a session with a medium changed the direction of his life. He went on to spend years working with mediums and channels to explore the pre-birth plans of many people, and wrote three books on the subject, Your Soul's Plan, Your Soul's Gift and Your Soul's Love, which have been translated into more than twenty-five languages.

Since 2012 he has offered Between Lives Soul Regression sessions, a form of hypnosis in which a person revisits a past life and then speaks with a council of wise, loving guides about their current life plan. He is clear that he is neither a medium nor a channel himself. He teaches internationally, at venues including Kripalu, 1440 Multiversity and Hollyhock, and online through The Shift Network. With his wife, Liesel Fricke, who channels a group they call the Beings of Light, he leads online group regressions and Rise to the Path, a monthly membership and mentoring community.

books.title: Your Soul's Plan: Discovering the Real Meaning of the Life You Planned Before You Were Born
books.author: Robert Schwartz
books.description: Rob's first book, built on conversations with mediums and channels about the pre-birth plans of ordinary people. Through their life stories it explores why a soul might choose hard experiences, such as the death of a loved one, for the sake of growth.

books.title: Your Soul's Gift: The Healing Power of the Life You Planned Before You Were Born
books.author: Robert Schwartz
books.description: A second collection of life stories and pre-birth planning sessions, with material from mediums, channels and Between Lives Soul Regressions. It looks at how understanding a life plan can bring acceptance, forgiveness and peace.

books.title: Your Soul's Love: Living the Love You Planned Before You Were Born
books.author: Robert Schwartz
books.description: Rob's third book applies pre-birth planning to love and relationships, drawing on sessions with mediums and channels. It looks at partners, family and self-love as relationships the soul chose before birth.

courses.title: Awakening to the Spiritual Purpose of the Life You Planned Before Birth
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced Shift Network course with Rob and Liesel Fricke. It uses guided regression, meditation and channelled messages to explore your pre-birth plan and the qualities your soul came to develop.

courses.title: The Spiritual Ascension Program
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced Shift Network course with Rob and Liesel Fricke on the idea of a collective spiritual ascension. It combines hypnotic meditations, channelled messages from the Beings of Light and lessons on forgiveness, gratitude and acceptance.

courses.title: Attune Your Intuition
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced Shift Network course with Rob and Liesel Fricke for empaths and sensitive people. It includes meditation, a hypnotic regression, channelled messages and exercises on intuition, life purpose and forgiveness.

courses.title: Between Lives Soul Regression (private session)
courses.description: A private hypnosis session of up to two hours over Zoom, recorded for you. Rob guides you into a past life connected with your present one and then to your council of guides, where you ask your own questions about your life plan.

courses.title: Rise to the Path membership
courses.description: A membership and mentoring community led by Rob and Liesel Fricke, with a live online session every third Tuesday of the month and recordings of all sessions. Members also receive discounts on workshops, sessions and books.
courses.price: $25 USD/month, $135 USD every 6 months or $240 USD/year (first 30 days free)

courses.title: Connect with a Deceased Loved One online workshop
courses.description: A two-hour evening workshop with Rob and Liesel Fricke built around a group hypnotic regression for contacting a loved one who has died, followed by journalling and sharing. Not recorded.

courses.title: Between Lives Soul Regression online workshop
courses.description: A live online day workshop in which Rob guides the group through a Between Lives Soul Regression to explore what each person planned for this life and why. Not recorded.
courses.price: $199 USD ($169 USD early bird until 13 November 2026)

free_resources.title: Free excerpt from Your Soul's Love
free_resources.description: A free PDF excerpt from Rob's book Your Soul's Love, offered in return for signing up to his newsletter. A way to read some of the book before buying it.

Private session price is shown only inside the booking calendar, so 'Contact for pricing'. Sessions are a main way he works, so one session item is included.

Your Soul's Gift subtitle says 'The Healing Power of…' and Your Soul's Plan's blurb on his site lists illness, disability and addiction among the challenges explored; titles kept, descriptions written without conditions — check you are happy.
His sessions page carries client testimonials naming fibromyalgia, depression and pain; nothing of that is used, but the booking_url points there.
Shift course prices are sale prices (regular $347 for the $297 courses and $297 for the $247 course).
Free excerpt is a newsletter sign-up gift (email needed); the form sits on several pages, I used the Your Soul's Love book page.
